pages.text: With the Skeleton Horse behind you, you began to consider the possibility of a Wither Skeleton Horse; luckily for you, it was not difficult at all.

The Wither Skeleton Horse Servant is tougher than an ordinary Skeleton Horse Servant and far more aggressive.$(br)You can feed your Wither Skeleton Horse Servant bones to heal it.$(br)Health 30 / Attack 3 / Armor 2 / Speed 0.3 / Follow Range 24; 1.2x the size of a Skeleton Horse Servant.$(br)Hits apply Wither I for 3s.

Riding works like the Skeleton Horse: no saddle, right-click empty-handed to mount, sneak + empty hand to take the armour back.$(br)One summoned with a Nether wand plus the full Nether set comes with netherite horse armour (+15 armor / +6 toughness / +0.6 knockback resistance, 17 armor in total) and refuses player-given armour.
